title: French Teacher
summary: A highly regarded secondary school with a thriving sixth form is seeking a passionate French teacher. ECTs welcome.
body:
## The position

Are you an inspiring French teacher ready to make a meaningful impact in a vibrant, supportive school community? A highly regarded secondary school in Basildon is seeking a passionate French teacher to join their team as soon as possible, on a permanent contract.

## About the school

Our client is committed to developing the whole child, with a curriculum designed to build knowledge, understanding and skills so students become lifelong learners. It offers linguistic, mathematical, scientific, technical, human, social, physical and artistic learning, so students make strong progress across a wide range of subjects.

High expectations are set for every student. The setting is calm, orderly and purposeful, so students enjoy their learning, feel safe and achieve well.

The sixth form is an integral part of the school, structured to promote independent, university-style study. Young people are encouraged to take on mature responsibilities and get involved in academy life, building the skills they need for higher education or employment.

## The role

The school operates across two sites: one teaches Key Stage 3, while the other specialises in Key Stages 4 and 5. The successful candidate will begin at the Key Stage 3 site.

The post is open to teachers at every level of experience, and applications from ECTs are very welcome.
